title: ExamLeaf animation style tokens (structural summary of the canonical file)
description: Describes the shape of 12_advanced_animations_with_claude/05_style_guides/style_tokens.json, which is the canonical data and the worked example. Only the keys the validator relies on are listed; other keys are allowed. Semantic rules (display-font bans, Inter roles, Indic coverage, boil range, finite repeats, forbidden flags, version bumps) are enforced by scripts/validate_style_tokens.py.

coverage_enum.description: Allowed script_coverage values: yes, claimed_verify, assumed_none, n_a

determinism.description: seeded_prng_required, wall_clock_forbidden, raf_loops_forbidden, finite_repeats_only, fonts_preloaded_before_first_frame, double_render_frame_hash_test must all be true.

ban_as_display.description: Must include Arial, Inter, Space Grotesk [N51][N55].

inter_allowed_for.description: House decision: Inter only for these non-display roles.

indic_animation_unit.description: word or grapheme cluster, never code point (#55).

forbidden.description: true means forbidden. Required true: image_model_text_numbers_formulae, full_frame_flash, infinite_repeats, math_random, per_codepoint_indic_animation, camera_fx_during_label_or_measurement_reveal, crop_16x9_into_9x16, agent_writes_or_edits_script, agent_researches_facts, read_other_folders, ultracode, dont_stop_until_perfect.

indic_rules_active.description: When true, every style must route Devanagari and Bengali-Assamese text to a covering font.

licence.description: 'verify' until a human records the licence.

guide.description: File next to the tokens file in 05_style_guides/.

credits.description: Prices are never stored; the storyboard gate estimates.

palette.description: Any #rrggbb values; accent limit via usage.max_foreground_accent_hues or max_accent_colours (<= 3) [N52].

fonts.description: Lists primary, secondary, handwriting, science_text, number_callout hold fonts_registry ids; each list has a <key>_role text used to detect display roles; indic_fallback maps script-specific roles to registry ids.

motion.description: boil fps values within 8-10; repeats finite.
